---
title: '20260527'
version: 0.54.0
date: 2026-05-27
description: Browse changes by file type, edit and reorder queued messages, rename workspaces from Settings, and get fixes for startup, navigation, session state, theming, and Markdown rendering.
---
### New

- The Changes view can now group changed files by type, and the session sidebar can count only code changes.
- Queued messages can now be edited in place and reordered by drag and drop.
- Workspaces can now be renamed from Settings.

### Fixes and Improvements

- Fixed image uploads on newly opened tab conversation pages.
- Fixed a startup white screen on older browsers such as iOS Safari 16.0, where unsupported regex lookbehind could break app initialization; Lody now guides affected users to upgrade their browser.
- Fixed desktop and mobile startup white screens.
- Fixed in-flight message sending being interrupted during cross-page navigation.
- Fixed preview session status not staying in sync.
- Fixed activity from child tabs not rolling up to the parent session, which made parent-session sorting and unread state inaccurate.
- Fixed the app not following the system theme setting.
- Polished Markdown rendering: single-line code blocks are vertically centered, block spacing and heading scale are preserved, list items have visible spacing, and horizontal rules are visible again.
